rows.grounds: Causative optative expressing a prescribed ritual action of lowering or drawing down.
Instrumental plural indicating the sacred syllables used as the means of the action.
Vocative address to the goddess within the revelatory dialogue.
Accusative object denoting the subtle city or abode to be acted upon.
Fused form with internal boundary marked by '+'; describes the city as constituted of echo or reverberant sound.
Indeclinable particle reinforcing direction toward the object.

items.question: By what sonic means is the echo-formed city to be ritually drawn down?
premises: A ritual action of causing descent is enjoined.
The praṇavas serve as the instrumental means of this action.
The object of descent is a city characterized as made of echo or sound.
items.inference: The echo-formed city is to be drawn down through the application of the praṇavas.
uncertainties: The precise referent of 'purīṃ' as a subtle body, diagrammatic abode, or other locus is not specified in this verse.
The function of the repeated 'prati' is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: O Goddess, one should cause the echo-made city to descend by means of the praṇavas.
